# OvenMedia Labs

> OvenMedia Labs Inc. (formerly AirenSoft Co., Ltd., rebranded February 2026) is a media technology company specializing in real-time live streaming. Makers of OvenMediaEngine, an open-source sub-second latency streaming server, and OvenMedia Cloud, a fully managed live streaming service operated by the core engineering team. Founded in 2010, Seoul, South Korea.

## Products

- [OvenMedia Cloud](https://ovenmedia.com/om-cloud): Fully managed live streaming service designed, deployed, and operated by the OvenMediaEngine core team.
- [OvenMediaEngine Enterprise](https://ovenmedia.com/): Commercial edition of OvenMediaEngine with Web Console, advanced security, high availability, and direct-to-engineer support. Self-hosted, per-instance pricing.
- [OvenMediaEngine Enterprise on AWS (CPU)](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-66xy6t4xk56xs): OvenMediaEngine Enterprise on AWS Marketplace for CPU-based instances. 14-day free trial, hourly billing.
- [OvenMediaEngine Enterprise on AWS (GPU)](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-xgqlshxeegf5c): OvenMediaEngine Enterprise on AWS Marketplace for GPU-accelerated instances. 14-day free trial, hourly billing.
- [OvenMediaEngine (Open Source)](https://github.com/OvenMediaLabs/OvenMediaEngine): Open-source (AGPLv3) sub-second latency streaming server supporting WebRTC, LL-HLS, SRT, RTMP, and more. 3,300+ GitHub stars.
- [OvenPlayer](https://github.com/OvenMediaLabs/OvenPlayer): Open-source HTML5 JavaScript player supporting WebRTC, LL-HLS, HLS, and DASH with automatic protocol fallback.
- [OvenLiveKit](https://github.com/OvenMediaLabs/OvenLiveKit-Web): Open-source JavaScript browser-based live encoder SDK using WebRTC/WHIP, targeting OvenMediaEngine.

## Company

- [About OvenMedia Labs](https://ovenmedia.com/company): Media Technology Experts Group. Founded 2010. 16+ years of media technology expertise. 20+ countries with production deployments.
- [Contact](https://ovenmedia.com/company#contact): contact@ovenmedia.com
